scientific_choices.rationale: PSENet-inspired two-map adaptation; not original PSENet. Generate a connected native nucleus independently per qualified v4 owner using half-max interior distance and largest-CC selection.
Keep existing v4 full-mask, validity, separation and letterbox transform unchanged. Replay spatial augmentation for owners and form nuclei only within valid full target.
GT-blind simultaneous 8-neighbour BFS inside full predicted foreground; deterministic equal-distance ties, no instance fusion; preserve unseeded full CC as fallback.
Reuse pre-existing TRAIN-selected foreground 0.65, freeze kernel 0.5 before any run, select checkpoint only on held-out TRAIN word F1; no threshold grid or TEST selection.
Existing practical letterbox native256 architecture plus one output channel; frozen pretrained ResNet50 and existing optimizer. No frequency adapter.
